evidence.title: GSAR: Goal-State-Anchor Rewards for Mobile GUI Agents with Self-Evolving Data Synthesis

summary: A new study presents Goal-State-Anchor Rewards (GSAR), a method to improve mobile GUI agents by dynamically synthesizing training data. The approach aims to enhance agent performance in real-world mobile interface tasks.
title: Researchers Introduce GSAR: A New Reward Model for Mobile GUI Agents with Self-Evolving Data Synthesis
